item.title: Apple Signs Deal for Brandon Sanderson's 'Cosmere' Universe Movies and TV Shows
item.description: Apple has signed a deal with popular fantasy author Brandon Sanderson for film and TV rights to Sanderson's "Cosmere" universe, according to The Hollywood Reporter. Sanderson has a large body of work, but some of his most popular fantasy books could be adapted first. Mistborn could be turned into a movie series, while The Stormlight Archive is being considered for television. item.description: AI-powered browsing features have become a battleground among browser makers in recent months. item.title: iPhone 16 Tops List of World's Best-Selling Smartphones in 2025
item.description: Apple's iPhone 16 was the best-selling smartphone globally in 2025, according to Counterpoint Research's latest report. Apple and Samsung devices dominated the top 10 list for the fourth consecutive year, accounting for 19% of overall smartphone sales. Apple claimed seven of the top 10 spots, while Samsung captured the remaining three. item.title: Apple Pushes Carrier Settings Update to Fix Telstra Issue on iPhones Running iOS 16.7.3
item.description: Apple has released a carrier settings update for Telstra customers in Australia that resolves the issue affecting iPhones running iOS 16.7.3, which was released and then made unavailable to download by Apple earlier this week.
